reason: Integrated the observation-only KernelProfile capability into UX-ROM using 12 documented aggregate performance counters, three repeated correlated blocks, complete raw-sample and block-median distributions, explicit snapshot calibration, sanitized environment capture, and WPR/WPA attribution-readiness detection. The passive lab run retained 3 blocks and 15 samples; one complete snapshot measured 1026.9263 ms median and 1030.7171 ms p95, while block excess was retained rather than subtracted. WPR was available and idle, but WPA and WPA Exporter were unavailable, so no trace or module attribution was attempted. The full relevant suite passed 114 tests. No scheduler, interrupt, memory, storage, driver, service, registry, power, trace-session, or Windows state changed, and no responsible-driver, harmful-threshold, or performance-gain claim was made.
